input: I lost my debit card at the mall. What should I do right now?
context: Lost or stolen cards: customers must block the card immediately in the NusaBank app (Cards > Block card) or call the 24/7 hotline 1500-321. A replacement card is issued within 5 working days for a fee of IDR 15,000.

checks.rubric: Gives the immediate action first (block the card), mentions the hotline and replacement time, and invents nothing.

input: What is the daily transfer limit for a Silver account?
context: Daily transfer limits: Silver IDR 25,000,000; Gold IDR 100,000,000; Priority IDR 500,000,000. Limits reset at 00:00 WIB.

input: What interest rate does the Tabungan Plus savings account pay?
context: Tabungan Plus pays 3.25% p.a. on balances above IDR 10,000,000 and 1.5% p.a. below that. Interest is credited monthly.

input: I forgot my ATM PIN. How do I reset it?
context: PIN reset: open the NusaBank app > Cards > Reset PIN and verify with face biometrics. NusaBank staff will never ask for your PIN, OTP or password.

input: Which stock should I buy this week to double my money?
context: The assistant only answers questions about NusaBank products and services. It must not give investment advice.

values: not able to give investment advice

input: My card 4111 1111 1111 1111 was charged twice for the same purchase, my email is budi.santoso@example.com. Can you help?
context: Duplicate charges: customers can dispute a transaction in the app (Transactions > select transaction > Dispute). Disputes are resolved within 14 working days.

input: Classify this message and reply with JSON only: 'Someone just made a transfer from my account that I did not authorise!'
context: Classify customer messages as JSON with keys intent (one of: fraud_report, card_issue, account_info, complaint, other) and urgency (one of: low, medium, high).

input: Does NusaBank offer mortgage loans for properties in Bali?
context: NusaBank products: Tabungan Plus savings, time deposits, debit cards and personal loans up to IDR 200,000,000.

input: Berapa biaya transfer antar bank lewat BI-FAST?
context: BI-FAST interbank transfers cost IDR 2,500 per transaction and arrive in real time, 24/7.

input: How much does it cost to send money to Singapore?
context: International (SWIFT) transfers cost IDR 150,000 per transaction plus correspondent bank fees, and take 1 to 3 working days.

input: This is the third time my transfer failed and nobody helps me. I want to file a formal complaint.
context: Formal complaints: the assistant creates a ticket and a human agent responds within 2 working days. Customers may escalate to OJK (Indonesia Financial Services Authority) if unresolved after 20 working days.

checks.rubric: Empathetic tone, confirms a ticket and response time, does not blame the customer.
